sources.license_status: TACO annotations CC BY 4.0; use only images explicitly marked ODBL (c) OpenLitterMap & Contributors. The TACO annotation file marks 715 images with no license, 319 as generic CC, and 466 ODbL. Other image licenses are excluded.

Aerosol.reason: not one of the selected four material groups; contents and residue are not inferred

Aluminium blister pack.reason: composite medication packaging; do not infer a single material or handling stream

Battery.reason: hazardous object; preserve image for specialist review, not a material-only guess

Broken glass.reason: explicit glass annotation; advice must retain broken-glass safety warning

Carded blister pack.reason: composite packaging; not paper or plastic by assumption

Cigarette.reason: specific cigarette-butt litter object; advice is residual waste, never cigarette recycling

Corrugated carton.reason: paper/cardboard has only 19 boxes after license and ambiguity filtering; excluded from this run rather than forced into a weak fifth-class head

Crisp packet.reason: often multilayer; do not infer recyclable plastic from appearance or name

Disposable food container.reason: container composition may be composite or unknown

Disposable plastic cup.reason: explicit plastic object annotation; material label is not a recycling guarantee

Drink can.reason: explicit can object; advice remains conditional on residue/local collection

Drink carton.reason: composite or lined paper object; excluded from this model and not forced into a weak class

Egg carton.reason: paper/cardboard is out of scope for this 4-class run due insufficient reviewed boxes

Foam cup.reason: explicit foam polymer cup annotation; no recycling claim

Foam food container.reason: explicit foam polymer annotation; no recycling claim

Food Can.reason: explicit metal can object; contents/residue not inferred

Food waste.reason: known non-target category; organic material is outside this four-class dataset

Garbage bag.reason: bag composition and layers are not specified

Magazine paper.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes

Meal carton.reason: composite or lined paper object; excluded from this model and not forced into a weak class

Normal paper.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes

Other carton.reason: composite or lined paper object; excluded from this model and not forced into a weak class

Other plastic.reason: source explicitly annotates plastic material; no object-specific recycling claim

Other plastic container.reason: source explicitly annotates plastic material; handling remains conditional

Other plastic wrapper.reason: wrapper may be multilayer; don't assume single-material recycling

Paper bag.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes; multilayer-plastified bag is never assumed to be paper

Paper cup.reason: composite or lined paper object; excluded from this model and not forced into a weak class

Paper straw.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes

Pizza box.reason: paper/cardboard may be food-contaminated; image label alone cannot establish handling

Plastic film.reason: source explicitly annotates plastic film; material label is not a recycling guarantee

Plastic glooves.reason: known non-target protective item; no recycling stream inferred

Plastic utensils.reason: explicit plastic material annotation; no recycling guarantee

Plastified paper bag.reason: composite or lined paper object; excluded from this model and not forced into a weak class

Polypropylene bag.reason: explicit polypropylene material annotation; local acceptance still varies

Rope & strings.reason: fiber/composition is unspecified; excluded instead of guessing rubber or plastic

Shoe.reason: shoe is a composite object; do not classify every shoe as rubber

Tissues.reason: used tissue has sanitary handling considerations; not ordinary recyclable paper

Toilet tube.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes

Tupperware.reason: explicit plastic object annotation; no recycling guarantee

Unlabeled litter.reason: target material cannot be established; drop any image containing this label

Wrapping paper.reason: paper is out of scope for this run due insufficient reviewed boxes
